skills.name: git
skills.description: AI-powered git helpers — commit messages, code review, PR descriptions, and change explanations. Use when the user asks about git workflows, wants to commit/review/describe changes, or is working with claude-git. This is the index skill; individual commands are in the sibling skill files.

skills.name: git-msg
skills.description: Propose a conventional commit message for current staged/unstaged changes without committing. Use when the user wants a commit message suggestion, asks "what should I name this commit", or types /git-msg.

skills.name: git-commit
skills.description: Propose a conventional commit message and commit staged/unstaged changes after confirmation. Use when the user wants to commit changes, asks Claude to commit, or types /git-commit. Accepts optional -y/--yes flag to skip confirmation.

skills.name: git-prefix
skills.description: Propose a commit message prefixed with a ticket ID (e.g. CMB-1234) and commit after confirmation. Auto-detects Jira-style ticket from the branch name when no ID is given. Use when the user wants a prefixed commit, mentions a ticket number, or types /git-prefix.

skills.name: git-review
skills.description: Review current staged/unstaged changes for bugs, security issues, and logic errors. Use when the user wants a code review before committing, asks "is this safe to commit", or types /git-review.

skills.name: git-pr
skills.description: Generate a pull request description from commits ahead of a base branch. Use when the user wants to write a PR, asks for a PR description, or types /git-pr. Accepts an optional base branch argument (default: main).

skills.name: git-explain
skills.description: Explain what the current staged/unstaged changes do in plain English. Use when the user asks "what does this change do", "explain my changes", or types /git-explain.
